name: md-to-html
description: Generate content-aware, standalone HTML from Markdown files with a layout chosen for each document.

interface.shortDescription: Turn Markdown into standalone, content-aware HTML.
interface.longDescription: md-to-html reads a Markdown file, identifies whether the document is table-heavy, procedural, comparative, code-heavy, deeply structured, or article-like, then generates a single self-contained HTML page with inline CSS and lightweight inline JavaScript.
interface.defaultPrompt: Convert this Markdown file to a standalone HTML page.
